  path={"/synonyms/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces a synonym entry with the request body. Send every field that you want
to keep: fields that you leave out reset to their defaults. The entry keeps its
`id` and `created_at` values, and `updated_at` changes to the time of the update.

The `term` must stay unique within the synonym set, regardless of case. If
another entry in the set already has the new `term`, the API returns
`409 Conflict`.
